about: Study and work: the choice at 18, careers, raises, layoffs, mentors and side businesses.

vars.st: leftAt ? M('.xl', {a: leftAt, sk: Math.round(sk)}) : M('.xf', {sk: Math.round(sk)})

opts.ok: leftAt ? M('.left', {a: leftAt}) : (uniPlace || sk >= 26 || M('.noPlace', {p: Math.round(100 * uniRate())}))

en..xl: You left school at {a}. Your skill is {sk}.
en..left: You left school at {a}: university needs a secondary school certificate.
en..leftDip: You left school at {a}: a diploma course needs lower secondary school.
en..noPlace: No university place for you: here about {p} in 100 who finish school get one.
en..sch: Your grades win a scholarship that covers 60% of university fees.
en..rich: Your family will pay all your fees.
en..middle: Your family can pay half your fees.
en..none: Your family cannot help with fees.
en..uni.s: You pay {c} in fees{loan}. Part-time pay only while you study.
en..uni.h: Skill +{e}, which lifts your pay about {p}% for the rest of your career.
en..dip.s: You pay {c}, and you start work 2 years sooner.
en..work.s: A full salary from today. No fees, no debt, and four extra years to save.

zh..xl: 你{a}岁就离开了学校，技能是{sk}。
zh..left: 你{a}岁就离开了学校：上大学需要中学毕业证书。
zh..leftDip: 你{a}岁就离开了学校：读文凭课程需要读完初中。
zh..noPlace: 你没有拿到大学名额：在这里，读完中学的人大约每100人中有{p}人能上大学。
zh..sch: 你的成绩赢得了奖学金，可以抵掉60%的大学学费。
zh..rich: 家里会帮你付全部学费。
zh..middle: 家里可以帮你付一半学费。
zh..none: 家里没办法帮你付学费。
zh..uni.s: 你要付{c}学费{loan}。读书期间只有兼职收入。
zh..uni.h: 技能 +{e}，之后整个职业生涯工资大约多{p}%。
zh..dip.s: 你要付{c}，而且早2年开始工作。
zh..dip.h: 技能 +{e}，一辈子工资大约多{p}%。
zh..work.s: 从今天起领全薪。没有学费，没有债，还多出四年可以存钱。

zht..xl: 你{a}歲就離開了學校，技能是{sk}。
zht..left: 你{a}歲就離開了學校：上大學需要中學畢業證書。
zht..leftDip: 你{a}歲就離開了學校：讀文憑課程需要讀完國中。
zht..noPlace: 你沒有拿到大學名額：在這裡，讀完中學的人大約每100人中有{p}人能上大學。
zht..sch: 你的成績贏得了獎學金，可以抵掉60%的大學學費。
zht..rich: 家裡會幫你付全部學費。
zht..middle: 家裡可以幫你付一半學費。
zht..none: 家裡沒辦法幫你付學費。
zht..uni.s: 你要付{c}學費{loan}。讀書期間只有兼職收入。
zht..uni.h: 技能 +{e}，之後整個職業生涯工資大約多{p}%。
zht..dip.s: 你要付{c}，而且早2年開始工作。
zht..dip.h: 技能 +{e}，一輩子工資大約多{p}%。
zht..work.s: 從今天起領全薪。沒有學費，沒有債，還多出四年可以存錢。

events.src: choosing a career: every career, grouped by family (grp), locked ones show why. It comes back whenever a career ends

opts.label: M('car.' + id)
opts.sub: c.tr ? M('car.s.tr', {n: c.tr.y, p: MN(c.tr.pay * base), f: MN(c.tr.fee * base), a: a}) : c.req.cap ? M('car.s.cap', {c: MN(c.req.cap * base), a: a}) : M('car.s', {a: a})

en..x: Time to decide what you'll do for a living. Some careers need a degree, good health or savings to start.
en.car.s.tr: {n} years of training first, on {p} a year with {f} a year in fees. Then about {a} a year.
en.car.s.cap: You put in {c} of your savings. Then about {a} a year to start.
en..x2: Time for a new career. Some of what you've learned carries over.

zh..x: 是时候决定靠什么谋生了。有些职业要学历、好身体或一笔积蓄才能入行。
zh.car.s.tr: 先培训{n}年，每年收入{p}、学费{f}。之后每年约{a}。
zh..x2: 是时候换一份新职业了。你学到的东西能带走一部分。

zht..x: 是時候決定靠什麼謀生了。有些職業要學歷、好身體或一筆積蓄才能入行。
zht.car.s.tr: 先受訓{n}年，每年收入{p}、學費{f}。之後每年約{a}。
zht..x2: 是時候換一份新職業了。你學到的東西能帶走一部分。

events.src: every so often, and the year after a layoff or an injury: stay, or choose a new career

when.test: swAt != null && age >= swAt && age < 62 && !(job.train > age)

events.text: M('.x' + (swWhy ? '.' + swWhy : ''), { x: M('car.a.' + job.id), n: age - job.start })
events.again: delete done.switch; swWhy = null; if (job) swAt = age + 6 + Math.floor(roll('swAt') * 5)

en..x: You've been {x} for {n} years. A friend asks if you've ever thought about doing something else.
en..x.lay: After the layoffs, you wonder: keep working as {x}, or try something new?
en..x.inj: Your injury has healed, but it got you thinking. Keep working as {x}, or change?
en..stay.s: Keep your experience and your level.
en..go.s: Choose a new career now. Only part of your experience carries over.
en..h: In the same family of careers you keep half your experience and drop two levels; in a new family you keep a fifth and start at the bottom.

zh..x: 你当{x}已经{n}年了。朋友问你有没有想过换一行。
zh..x.lay: 裁员之后，你开始想：继续当{x}，还是换条路？
zh..x.inj: 伤好了，但这让你开始思考：继续当{x}，还是转行？
zh..go.s: 现在就选一份新职业。经验只能带走一部分。
zh..h: 留在同一类职业，保留一半经验、降两级；换到新的类别，只保留五分之一，从最低做起。

zht..x: 你當{x}已經{n}年了。朋友問你有沒有想過換個跑道。
zht..x.lay: 裁員之後，你開始想：繼續當{x}，還是換條路？
zht..x.inj: 傷好了，但這讓你開始思考：繼續當{x}，還是轉行？
zht..go.s: 現在就選一份新職業。經驗只能帶走一部分。
zht..h: 留在同一類職業，保留一半經驗、降兩級；換到新的類別，只保留五分之一，從最基層做起。

later.nego: const ok = roll(x.lv ? 'negoShop' : 'nego') < x.p; if (ok) { if (x.lv) level = Math.max(0, level - 1); bump('nego', x.m, M(x.lk)); } else happy -= 2; log(M(ok ? 'log.negoOk' : 'log.negoNo', { p: Math.round((x.m - 1) * 100) }), ok ? 'good' : 'bad')

en..x: You earn {a} a year. Your manager offers the standard raise.
en..h: Your chance of a yes is about {p}%, and more skill raises it.
en..ask.s: About {a} more a year if they say yes. They might say no.
en..shop: Interview elsewhere for a better offer
en..shop.s: Aim for about 15% more. You may have to start one level lower.
en..accept.s: No risk and no awkward conversation.

zh..x: 你年薪{a}。上司给你标准加薪。
zh..h: 对方答应的机会大约{p}%，技能越高机会越大。
zh..ask.s: 如果答应，每年多赚约{a}。也可能被拒绝。
zh..shop: 去别家面试，争取更好的条件
zh..shop.s: 目标是多15%左右，但可能要降一级入职。
zh..accept.s: 没有风险，也不用尴尬地谈。

zht..x: 你年薪{a}。主管給你標準調薪。
zht..h: 對方答應的機會大約{p}%，技能越高機會越大。
zht..ask.s: 如果答應，每年多賺約{a}。也可能被拒絕。
zht..shop: 去別家面試，爭取更好的條件
zht..shop.s: 目標是多15%左右，但可能要降一級到職。
zht..accept.s: 沒有風險，也不用尷尬地談。

opts.label: M('.go', { c: { k: '_c', ci: di } })
opts.do: pay(.2 * base); abroad = di; costMul = cm; happy -= 4; bump('abroad', m, M('trk.abroad', { c: { k: '_c', ci: di } }))

en..x: A company in {c} offers you a job. You would be far from your family and friends.
en..go.s: Pay of {a} a year (you earn {b} now). Rent and daily costs are about {p}% higher. Moving costs {m}. Happiness −4.
en..stay.s: Your life stays as it is.

zh..x: {c}的一家公司给你一份工作。你会离家人和朋友很远。
zh..go.s: 年薪{a}（你现在是{b}）。房租和日常开销大约高{p}%。搬家要花{m}。幸福感 −4。

zht..x: {c}的一家公司給你一份工作。你會離家人和朋友很遠。
zht..go.s: 年薪{a}（你現在是{b}）。房租和日常開銷大約高{p}%。搬家要花{m}。幸福感 −4。

en..x: Your manager says people with a professional qualification get promoted faster.
en..mba.s: {a} in fees and 10% less pay for 2 years.

zh..x: 上司说，有专业资格的人升职更快。

zht..x: 上司說，有專業資格的人升職更快。

opts.ok: liq >= 1.2 * B || M('.need', { n: MN(1.2 * B), h: MN(liq) })
liq >= .25 * B || M('.need', { n: MN(.25 * B), h: MN(liq) })

en..x: You've spotted a gap in the market. Skill and years of side hustling make success more likely.
en..h: Your chance of success is about {p}%.
en..full.s: Put in {a}. Low pay for 2 years. If it works, it can earn several times your salary.
en..side.s: Put in {a}. Keep your job. Smaller upside.

zh..x: 你发现了一个市场空缺。技能和做副业的年数都能提高成功率。
zh..full.s: 投入{a}。头2年收入很低。成功的话，能赚到工资的好几倍。
zh..side.s: 投入{a}。保留工作。上升空间较小。

zht..x: 你發現了一個市場空缺。技能和做副業的年數都能提高成功率。
zht..full.s: 投入{a}。頭2年收入很低。成功的話，能賺到工資的好幾倍。
zht..side.s: 投入{a}。保留工作。上升空間較小。

opts.do: cash += a; earned += a; layAt = age + 1; layVol = true; level = Math.max(0, level - 1); T('layoff', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.layoff'), v: a, note: M('note.layoff', { a: MN(a) }) })

later.lay: if (!job || retired) return; if (roll('lay') < x.p) { layAt = age; layVol = false; level = Math.max(0, level - 1); } else log(M('log.layNo'), 'good')

en..x: Your company is cutting jobs. Anyone who leaves now gets a package of one year's pay ({a}).
en..take.s: {a} now. You may be out of work for about six months and start a level lower.
en..stay.h: About a 45% chance you are laid off later without a package.

zh..x: 公司正在裁员。现在主动离职的人，可以拿到一年工资（{a}）的补偿。
zh..take.s: 现在拿{a}。你可能要失业半年左右，新工作也可能降一级。
zh..stay.h: 大约有45%的机会，之后还是被裁，而且没有补偿。

zht..x: 公司正在裁員。現在主動離職的人，可以拿到一年薪水（{a}）的資遣費。
zht..take.s: 現在拿{a}。你可能要失業半年左右，新工作也可能降一級。
zht..stay.h: 大約有45%的機會，之後還是被裁，而且沒有資遣費。

en..x: Your net worth is {a}, about {n} years of your spending. Some people stop working at this point.
en..now.s: Stop working this year. Your investments pay for the rest of your life.
en..part.s: Half the pay, much more free time. Happiness +4.
en.note.fire: Half the pay, much more free time

zh..x: 你的净资产是{a}，大约够你花{n}年。有些人到这一步就不工作了。
zh..now.s: 今年就不干了。下半辈子靠投资生活。
zh..part.s: 工资减半，自由时间多很多。幸福感 +4。
zh.note.fire: 工资减半，自由时间多很多

zht..x: 你的淨資產是{a}，大約夠你花{n}年。有些人到這一步就不工作了。
zht..now.s: 今年就不做了。下半輩子靠投資生活。
zht..part.s: 薪水減半，自由時間多很多。幸福感 +4。
zht.note.fire: 薪水減半，自由時間多很多

opts.do: pivoted = true; pivotYear = age; pay(.3 * base); const t = T('sk_pivot', { kind: 'skill', label: M('trk.pivot') }); t.cost += .3 * base; addSkill('pivot', 10, M('trk.pivot'))

en..x: New software is taking over parts of your job. Without new skills, your skill will slowly fall from 45 onward.
en..re.s: Half pay for one year and {a} in fees.
en..stay.h: Skill drops about 0.8 a year from 45.

zh..x: 新软件正在取代你的一部分工作。不学新技能的话，45岁起你的技能会慢慢下降。
zh..re.s: 一年只拿一半工资，外加{a}学费。

zht..x: 新軟體正在取代你的一部分工作。不學新技能的話，45歲起你的技能會慢慢下降。
zht..re.s: 一年只拿一半工資，外加{a}學費。

opts.do: T('team', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.team') }); rec('team', a, 5, -.2)
T('team', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.team') }); rec('team', a / 4, 5)

en..x: Your team often eats out together after work. Going every time costs about {a} a year.

zh..x: 你的团队常常下班一起吃饭。每次都去的话，一年大约要{a}。

zht..x: 你的團隊常常下班一起吃飯。每次都去的話，一年大約要{a}。

opts.do: T('mentor', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.mentorLunch') }); rec('mentor', a, 3); happy -= 2; if (mentorFit()) addSkill('mentor', 2.5, M('trk.mentor')); later(age + 3, 'mentor', { p: .3 })
spend('mentorC', .1 * a, 'trk.mentorLunch'); if (mentorFit()) addSkill('mentor', 1, M('trk.mentor')); later(age + 3, 'mentor', { p: .12 })

en..x: A senior colleague offers to meet you once a month to talk about your career, over lunch. You would pay.
en..yes: Say yes and buy the lunches
en..yes.s: About {a} a year for three years, and an evening a month. Happiness −2.
en..some: Meet now and then, over coffee
en..h: About 1 in 3 mentors turn out not to help much.

zh..x: 一位资深同事愿意每个月跟你吃顿午饭，聊聊你的职业发展。饭钱由你出。
zh..yes.s: 每年大约{a}，持续三年，每个月还要花一个晚上。幸福感 −2。
zh..h: 大约三分之一的导师其实帮不上什么忙。

zht..x: 一位資深同事願意每個月跟你吃頓午餐，聊聊你的職涯發展。餐費由你出。
zht..yes.s: 每年大約{a}，持續三年，每個月還要花一個晚上。幸福感 −2。
zht..h: 大約三分之一的導師其實幫不上什麼忙。

later.credit: const u = roll('credit'); if (u < relP(x.p)) { bump('credit', x.m, M('trk.credit')); log(M('log.creditOk', { p: Math.round((x.m - 1) * 100) }), 'good'); } else if (x.bad && u > 1 - x.bad) { happy -= 4; log(M('log.creditBad'), 'bad'); } else log(M('log.creditNo'), '')

en..x: A coworker presents your project to the bosses as their own work.
en..talk.h: They might start sharing the credit, which can lead to a raise.
en..boss.s: Free, but the whole office will notice.
en..boss.h: Often leads to a raise; sometimes you get a name for being difficult.

zh..x: 一位同事把你做的项目，当成自己的成果报告给老板。
zh..talk.h: 对方可能开始跟你分享功劳，这有机会带来加薪。
zh..boss.s: 不花钱，但整个办公室都会知道。
zh..boss.h: 常常能带来加薪；有时也会被当成难相处的人。
zh..let.s: 不花钱，但心里不好受。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 一位同事把你做的專案，當成自己的成果報告給老闆。
zht..talk.h: 對方可能開始跟你分享功勞，這有機會帶來加薪。
zht..boss.s: 不花錢，但整個辦公室都會知道。
zht..boss.h: 常常能帶來加薪；有時也會被當成難相處的人。
zht..let.s: 不花錢，但心裡不好受。幸福感 −2。

en..x: An industry group is holding an evening event. A ticket costs {a}.
en..follow: Go, and follow up with everyone you meet
en..follow.s: About {a} for the ticket and the coffees that follow, and a few evenings. Happiness −1.
en..cards: Go, collect business cards, leave early

zh..x: 一个行业协会举办晚间交流会，门票{a}。
zh..follow: 去，之后跟认识的人一一联络
zh..follow.s: 门票加上之后请人喝咖啡，大约{a}，还要花几个晚上。幸福感 −1。
zh..cards: 去，收几张名片就早点走

zht..x: 一個業界協會舉辦晚間交流會，門票{a}。
zht..follow: 去，之後跟認識的人一一聯絡
zht..follow.s: 門票加上之後請人喝咖啡，大約{a}，還要花幾個晚上。幸福感 −1。
zht..cards: 去，收幾張名片就早點走

opts.do: bump('uncle', 1.1, M('trk.uncle')); uncle = true; later(age + 4 + Math.floor(roll('uncAt') * 5), 'uncle')

later.uncle: if (!uncle) return; if (roll('uncle') < .5) { uncle = false; bump.uncle = 1; const t = trk.uncle; if (t) t.note = M('note.uncleEnd', { a: MN(t.v) }); if (job && !retired) { layAt = age; layVol = false; } log(M('log.uncleEnd'), 'bad'); } else log(M('log.uncleOk'), 'good')

en..x: Your uncle runs a family business and offers you a job paying {a} a year.
en..h: Family businesses tend to promote slowly, and about half run into trouble within a few years.
en..no: Thank him and stay where you are

zh..x: 你叔叔经营一家家族生意，想请你过去，年薪{a}。
zh..h: 家族生意升职通常比较慢，而且大约一半几年内会遇到困难。
zh..no: 谢谢他，留在原来的公司

zht..x: 你叔叔經營一家家族企業，想請你過去，年薪{a}。
zht..h: 家族企業升遷通常比較慢，而且大約一半幾年內會遇到困難。
zht..no: 謝謝他，留在原來的公司

opts.do: pay(.1 * base); bump('away', 1.2, M('trk.away')); trk.away.v -= .1 * base; happy -= 2

later.remote: const ok = roll('remote') < x.p; if (ok) bump('away', 1.12, M('trk.awayRemote')); log(M(ok ? 'log.remoteOk' : 'log.remoteNo'), ok ? 'good' : '')

en..x: Your company offers you a bigger role in another city: {a} a year instead of {b}. Your family and friends would be a long way off.
en..remote: Ask to do the job from here
en..remote.h: About 1 in 3 companies say yes, for a smaller raise.
en..stay: Turn it down and stay near family

zh..x: 公司给你一个在另一个城市的更高职位：年薪{a}，现在是{b}。可是离家人朋友就远了。
zh..remote: 问能不能留在这里远程做
zh..remote.h: 大约三家公司有一家会答应，但加薪会少一点。

zht..x: 公司給你一個在另一個城市的更高職位：年薪{a}，現在是{b}。可是離家人朋友就遠了。
zht..remote: 問能不能留在這裡遠端工作
zht..remote.h: 大約三家公司有一家會答應，但加薪會少一點。
